title: MCP server discoverable
question: Can an agent find an MCP server for this site through a documented route?
method: Look for a server card through the routes the MCP Server Card extension and the AI Catalog proposal describe: entries of type application/mcp-server-card+json in /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, a card at <endpoint>/server-card for an endpoint linked from llms.txt or a Link header, and the community paths /.well-known/mcp/server-card (the path the extension's discovery document names) and the older /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. Pass when a card parses with a name and an endpoint URL; warn when only a community path answers (neither is in the specification), saying which; fail when none does. When a card URL is refused or challenged (401, 403, 429, a bot-management challenge) or fails transiently, the check is inconclusive and names the refusal rather than reporting a missing card. The extension is not an accepted MCP extension and no host probes these files yet (agents are given MCP URLs by hand or through registries), hence the low weight.

title: API catalog
question: Does the site publish an API catalog linkset?
method: GET /.well-known/api-catalog. Pass on an application/linkset+json document (or a linkset parseable as JSON) with at least one item. Fail otherwise, including on 404 or 410. Skipped when the request was rate limited or failed (429, a gateway error or no response). No answer engine documents reading it: a convention.

title: OAuth discovery for the MCP endpoint
question: Can an agent discover how to authorize against the MCP server?
method: For the MCP endpoint found by A4.1, GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/<endpoint path> and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728, which the MCP specification requires of authorized servers), and /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 8414). Pass when protected resource metadata with authorization_servers is found, or when the endpoint answers 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header naming resource_metadata; warn when only authorization server metadata exists; fail when none does.

title: MCP endpoint reachable
question: Does the advertised MCP endpoint answer like an MCP server?
method: POST a JSON-RPC server/discover request (the read-only method the 2026-07-28 specification makes mandatory) to the endpoint from the server card, with the 2026-07-28 headers. Pass when the answer is a JSON-RPC message, whatever the status: a result, or the errors the Streamable HTTP transport prescribes (404 with -32601 from an older server that does not implement server/discover, 400 with -32020 on a header mismatch), or an event stream, or 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header (an authorized server). Fail on a 404 or other error without a JSON-RPC body, on 5xx, on 405, or on an HTML page. A 429, a gateway error or no response is inconclusive and skipped. This is the only request the scanner sends with a body; it creates nothing on the server. A server on the 2025 session transport that refuses server/discover with a plain HTTP 400 gets the initialize handshake once instead.

title: A2A agent card
question: Does the site publish a valid A2A agent card?
method: GET /.well-known/agent-card.json. Pass on JSON with the eight fields A2A 1.0 requires: name, description, supportedInterfaces, version, capabilities, defaultInputModes, defaultOutputModes and skills. Warn when a card lacks some fields, or is found only at the pre-0.3 path /.well-known/agent.json; JSON at that path counts as an A2A card only when it carries name, description, url or supportedInterfaces, version, capabilities and skills, because the path is also used by other agent-discovery drafts. Fail when none is found. No shopping agent documents reading agent cards from stores: a convention.

title: WebMCP tool declarations
question: Does the site declare in-page tools for browser agents?
method: Informational. On the home page and sampled product pages, look for forms that declare a WebMCP tool (toolname and tooldescription, with toolparamdescription on fields) and for document.modelContext or navigator.modelContext in inline scripts. Pass when found. Warn when a form carries toolname without tooldescription (the browser does not register it) or when the page's Permissions-Policy turns WebMCP off with tools=(). Not applicable when the HTML declares none; tools registered from bundled scripts are invisible to a scan that does not run JavaScript. The API is a W3C community draft in origin trials in Chrome and Edge with one shipping consumer (ChatGPT's site tools in its desktop browser); no shopping agent documents calling it on arbitrary stores, so this is reported and never scored.

spec.title: WebMCP (W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group draft)

title: WordPress REST API readable
question: Can an agent read the WordPress site's content through its REST API without signing in?
method: On a WordPress site (WooCommerce included), take the REST API root the page advertises with the api.w.org link relation (in the head or the Link header, else /wp-json/) and GET wp/v2/pages?per_page=1. Pass on 200 with a JSON array; fail on 401 or 403 (a security plugin or filter refuses anonymous reads, typically rest_not_logged_in), on 404 or on a non-JSON answer. Warn when robots.txt keeps the scanner from asking; skipped on 429 or a gateway error. WordPress advises against disabling the API, and the WooCommerce Store API runs on it.

title: Wix site MCP server answers
question: Does the MCP server Wix runs for every site answer agents?
method: On a Wix site, send the read-only JSON-RPC server/discover POST to /_api/mcp, where Wix documents an MCP server for every site that needs no authentication and that the generated llms.txt links. Pass on a JSON-RPC answer or an authorization challenge; fail when nothing answers; warn when robots.txt keeps the scanner from asking; skipped when the request fails. A server on the 2025 session transport that refuses server/discover with a plain HTTP 400 gets the initialize handshake once instead.

title: Shopware agentic files
question: Has the Shopware sales channel published its agentic files?
method: On a Shopware store, GET /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, one of the three agentic files (with /llms.txt and /agents.md) that Shopware 6.7.12 and later publishes when they are switched on for the sales channel. Pass on 200 with a JSON object; warn on 404 (the files are off, or the shop runs an older version) or a non-JSON answer, and when robots.txt keeps the scanner from asking; skipped on 429 or a gateway error.
